title: frasera nitida var. albicaulis
intro: Frasera nitida var. albicaulis, commonly known as White Mountain Indian Paintbrush or White Mountain Lomatium, is a perennial plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can aid in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and improving immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Frasera nitida var. albicaulis include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
